brief_rationale: The doctor systematically assessed immediate psychiatric safety (RC1), gave executable home safety instructions (RC2), addressed medication execution and boundaries (RC3), and built a staged-results and follow-up tracking plan (RC4). The model actively used workspace records to reconstruct the handoff gap (HO1), created a caregiver-friendly tracking system with owners and channels (HO2), explored minimized risk around weapon-seeking (HO3), and corrected medication/test misconceptions (HO4). All safety-critical duties were met without a responsibility-chain error, and multiple high-order points were completed with meaningful trajectory impact. The trajectory ends with a safe, traceable, and executable closure confirmed by caregiver teach-back.
